{{Quote|Cathar settlements cover this part of Taris. They're defending their homes under the leadership of a feral warrior. His name's Bashun. Some call him ferocious, brutal, terrifying. I say he's a dirty alien who needs to be put down.|[[General/Legends|General]] [[Farvin]]|<ref name="TOR:FotR" />}}
'''Bashun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]].<ref name="TOR:CA" /> During the [[Galactic War]], he was a leader of the Cathar settlers on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]].<ref name="TOR:FotR" /> [[General/Legends|General]] [[Farvin]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] sent [[Thana Vesh]] and another Imperial to confront Bashun in [[Bashun's stronghold|his stronghold]] and slay him. Sometime before his death there was a failed assassination attempt made on his life orchestrated by General Farvin.<ref name="TOR:CA" />
